title: LoL Esports |
content:
League of Legends Classic is all about celebrating League’s past and present, with a “greatest hits” feeling pulled from the game’s early years. And for a lot of players, that means remembering the days when online competition could light up a weekend, with thousands of teams jumping in, battling through brackets, and chasing one more shot at glory.

We want to bring a little of that feeling back.

This August, we’re hosting a new online 5v5 League of Legends Classic tournament series on the North American server. Each event will take place in a single day and feature a single-elimination bracket, giving teams a chance to relive the energy of early online competition.

The road to the finals begins with four qualifier tournaments, taking place every Saturday from August 1 through August 22. The top two teams from each qualifier will advance to the final tournament on Saturday, August 29, where they’ll compete for the top spot in North America.

If you’ve been waiting for a reason to round up your friends, lock in your roles, and jump back into that old-school competitive spirit, this is your moment.

We’ll have more details to share soon. Until then, you can catch up on League Classic in the200 Years of Experience | Dev Updateand the/dev: League of Legends Classicpost.

title: Applications Open: Worlds 2026 Artist Alley
summary: Applications Open: Worlds 2026 Artist Alley  League of Legends
content:
Worlds brings together the best teams, players, and fans from around the globe for an epic celebration of League of Legends at Fan Fest. In 2026, that celebration comes to New York City, and applications for the Artist Alley Presented by Mastercard are now open.

From champion fan art and handmade crafts to apparel, prints, and original creations, artists have been at the heart of the League community for more than fifteen years. To celebrate that creativity, Riot Games and Mastercard are inviting artists from around the world to be part of Fan Fest, creating a dedicated space where selected creators can showcase and sell their wares, connect with fellow fans, and bring their passion for League to life.

Applications for Artist Alley presented by Mastercard at Worlds 2026 Fan Fest arenow open!

Artists from all regions are encouraged to applyhere.
